notes.title: Vault Apocalypse Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
- Fixed the rest of achievements that were not unlocking correctly. Let me know if there are any further issues.
- Audio looping after player dies fixed.
- Abyss can no longer suck bosses up (oops!)

More content (enemies, bosses, powerups, etc) will hopefully come later this year when I have more time to work on them.

notes.title: Vault Apocalypse Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug causing certain achievements to not unlock after completing a run.

Gameplay Changes:
After some feedback, I have adjusted the unlock requirements of some weapons & accessories:

- Cataclysm unlocks after beating the game with both Rumble & Inferno equipped (was Rumble & Comet)
- Hex unlocks after beating the game with Vortex OR Enigma (was 5 familiars held)
- Sanguine unlocks after beating the game with Hex OR Cataclysm
- Comet unlocks after beating the game with Inferno (was 20 burning enemies killed)
- Abyss unlocks after beating the game with Necro (was Necro & Hex)
- Blood Vessel unlocks after beating the game with Ancient Tome
- Familiar Key unlocks after beating the game with Spiked Collar
- Thief's Slippers unlocks after beating the game with Blood Vessel OR Familiar Key.

- Boss health has been increased by ~100%.
- Boss damage has been increased.

Please give feedback and suggestions on the community hub or discord server (https://discord.gg/NS8PgEdbCe)

notes.title: Vault Apocalypse Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a gamebreaking bug that would occur on the end game screen.
- Difficulties should now correctly unlock after completing a run.

Gameplay changes:
- 'Shackle' now reduces speed by 10% instead of setting speed bonuses to 0 (this effect was bugged and causing player speed to be set to 0).

Please post any bugs or feedback to the community hub or let me know on the discord server:
https://discord.gg/NS8PgEdbCe

notes.title: Vault Apocalypse Patch 1.02
notes.content:
After some initial feedback, I've opted to give players more variety to start the game by instantly unlocking one extra primary, secondary & accessory.

- Luminar (Primary Weapon) is now unlocked immediately.
- Frostfang (Secondary Weapon) is now unlocked immediately
- Spiked Collar (Accessory) is now unlocked immediately.

- Fixed a bug stopping players from unlocking new difficulties.

Please let me know on the community forum or discord (https://discord.gg/79VGyR5b) if you have feedback or improvements.

notes.title: Vault Apocalypse Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Patch 1.01:

- Updated current boss music
- Added new boss music

Adjusted the unlocks of many heroes & weapons

- Bishop now requires 30 Max HP to unlock (was 50)
- Marksman now requires 30 Crit to unlock (was 50)
- Bandit now requires 2500 gems collected (was 10000)
- Miner now requires 600 Gems (was 1000)
- Doctor now requires 8+ Regen (was 10+)
- Survivor now requires finishing a wave with less than 3 health (was 1)
- Thief now requires completing 2 waves with no damage taken (was 3)
- Spectre now requires 3 runs completed (was 5)
- Frostfang now requires 20 frozen enemies killed by Frostfire bullets (was 100)
- Comet now requires 20 burning enemies killed (was 100)

In a future patch expect to see:

- Endless mode
- Challenges
- More weapons and powerups
- Many more bugfixes

notes.title: Vault Apocalypse 1.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
Vault Apocalypse 1.0 is out now!

Features:

* 12 Heroes
* 8 Primary Weapons
* 5 Secondary Weapons
* 5 Accessories
* 5 Difficulties
* 2 Bosses
* Over 100 Powerups!

If you have any issues or suggestions, please make a post on the community forum. Over the coming weeks, I will be fixing any leftover bugs that are reported. If there's any interest, I'll also add new content (weapons, powerups, bosses, etc).
